summary: Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for upgrading the Anime Shorts & Reels Studio to Master Standards V16: full sound library replacement with MaterialFoundry SoundFxLibrary, interactive canvas scrubber with drag-and-drop text/CTA repositioning, dynamic 9:16/16:9/1:1 aspect ratio switching, advanced VFX engine (3D parallax, dynamic relighting, rune particles with 0-100% intensity sliders and preset profiles), RPG/Manhwa styled UI overlays, and NotebookLM dynamic JSON ingestion with strict Edge-TTS pure text sanitation.
